name: user
description: Fetch a Codewars user's public profile by username: honor, clan, leaderboard rank, overall language ranks, and skills.

name: user_completed
description: List completed kata (coding challenges) for a Codewars username, paginated; returns kata ID, slug, name, completion time, and languages used.

name: user_authored
description: List kata authored by a Codewars username; returns each kata's ID, slug, name, rank, tags, and languages it supports.

name: kata
description: Fetch a single Codewars kata by ID or slug; returns name, description, rank (kyu), tags, languages, approval status, total completions, and satisfaction rating.
